Guide list without required language tag: pages 1-3, 87 unique; Workshop tag lists 21, subset of 87. Interface language English is not content language restriction.
Discussions: General and Support three pages each; Workshop four pages 56 topics. Not all historic discussions, comments, attachments or videos.
19 thread opening posts and 44 returned replies read. One selected thread failed SSL and remains directory only.
32 direct sharedfiles detail responses contained rate-limit text despite HTTP 200. No downloads, subscriptions, ratings, comments or archive extraction.
Web text extraction includes removal/incompatibility and subscription templates. Rendered visibility/state was not verified; these strings do not prove removals or any account action.
Web cached body can differ from current response. Current local thread HTML has 2026 developer reply to OpenSPH; older web snapshot only contains 2022 posts.

Some initial workshop discussion requests accidentally appended a second question mark before l=english; returned expected topic title/body; canonical source URLs from listings are retained separately.
